title: Cheap Racecar Challenge 3 Ep.8
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-52:53); 0:00-1:51 sponsor read; 1:51-4:03 giveaway-car handover (unnamed car, no specs); 41:59-43:08 brisket segment; 43:08-52:53 free-turbo hotline (giveaway turbo sizes only)

rules.fact: Tires are not a safety item; teams must buy tires within budget and must arrive at the race with a safe set (at least rears)
Ryan (the 'money guy') prices contested items on the board; he had not yet made corrections

accounting_notes.fact: Ty sold his own used Ranger turbo kit (6-year-old turbo, journal bearing, cast vs billet wheel argued) to the Mustang team; price to be set by Ryan; the wastegates with it are brand new and priced separately
Mustang team bought an onboard air compressor with 'little left in the budget' to avoid the CO2/air-pressure problems seen on Lumberjack
Accusation that the Mustang team is effectively a $25,000 build on a $15,000 budget
S10 team stresses its used fuel pump has documented Facebook Marketplace transaction

cars.nickname: none yet ('red truck'; 'Red Rocket' / 'Red Dragon' floated)
cars.status: Described as behind the others; needs rear end, wiring, fuel system

history.fact: First junkyard rear end (from a Ford Explorer) was the wrong one: could not take a C-clip eliminator, breaking the TBM brake plan
Replaced with a junkyard disc-brake rear end with ABS and 4-bolt pattern

rear_end.setup: Pinion angle set; spring perches from old rear end slightly off-size, gap filled with weld; axle tubes welded; C-clip eliminators fitted; wide offset wheels

suspension.rear: CalTracs to be set/preloaded on the ground; may need a new rear shackle; shocks still needed

transmission.notes: Trans must come out because flex plate was installed backwards (at Cameron's shop); crossmember is welded in on both sides

fuel_system.cell: fuel cell mounted in back of bed (weight over rear tires), opening cut in bed
fuel_system.notes: Discussion of switching fuels, leave room to swap lines
fuel_system.pump: used Facebook Marketplace pump, mounted with a home-made 2-hole bracket

weight_notes.fact: Front sits light; turbo (~30-40 lb) and coolant not yet installed

failures.part: Leaf spring perches initially installed backwards (per Jackstand)

targets.fact: Jackstand predicts the S10 will blow its head gaskets by day two

power_adder.brand_model: Ty's used Ranger turbo kit (journal-bearing turbo, ~6 years old) + new wastegates

tires.desc: wheels (Race Star) with dry-rotted tires; told to buy proper rears within budget

cars.status: Essentially done, waiting on a driveshaft

history.fact: On the earlier challenge car ('Lieutenant Dan') the hood flew off at ~150 mph

other_vehicles.desc: Giveaway car delivered to winners Justin and Amy (headed to Arkansas); model not stated; next up is the C7 ZR1 giveaway winner

giveaway_turbo_sizes.advice: 88 mm suggested for a supercharged Mustang switching to turbo

gameplay_hooks: wrong junkyard axle incompatible with C-clip eliminator
flex plate on backwards forces trans removal
used turbo with journal bearings valued by a judge
